column4: An absent section without a default (requests) remains absent; absent sections with defaults (display, lease) take those defaults (N1.1 defaults)

P1: absent snapshot takes unit.fields names in author order, excluding *_secret, type: blob and server (N1.1 computed)
P1: absent snapshot takes fields, then state.<name> of each unit.state in author order, except cursor (ADR-0091 item 3; V7-P022-SNAPSHOT-STATE-01)
P2: explicit journal.written gives deleted = "<t>.deleted"; an explicit value is retained (N1.1 computed)
P3: display without form becomes [{fields: [<unit.fields names in author order>]}], without title (N1.1 computed)
P4: a descriptor default is its explicit value; absent default, explicit inherit or type: blob gives null; for unit and table fields (N1.1 computed)
P5: a regex secret_in element without decoded takes true (N1.1 computed)
ordered: unit.fields and tables.<t>.fields become arrays of {name, ...} in author order, not alphabetical order (N1.1 ordered)
